android.desc:
QR & Barcode Scanner is the fastest and most user-friendly application. Change your Smartphone into a powerful QR & Barcode Scanner, QR Code Reader, Barcode scanner, and Data Matrix scanning utility. Open the app QR Barcode Scanner, point the camera at code and you’re done! Functions of QR & Barcode Scanner, QR & Barcode Reader include history of scanned QR codes and barcodes. 

QR Barcode Reader / QR Code Scanner functionality: Create QR, Scan QR from image, and Scan QR from Gallery, Share your contact info via QR, share images to scan from other apps, generate QR codes, share scan QR and barcode details to other. QR Barcode Scanner and Barcode reader can scan and read all QR / barcode types including text, url, ISBN, product, contact, calendar, email, location, Wi-Fi and many other formats.

Nowadays QR codes and barcodes are everywhere! Install QR & Barcode Scanner app to scan QR code or to scan barcode, you can also scan product barcodes. QR & Barcode Scanner app is the only free QR code reader / barcode scanner you will ever need.

This QR Scanner app is not just a QR Code Scanner and barcode reader; it's a comprehensive tool that ultimate all-in-one QR and Barcode scanning solution anytime, anywhere. You can generate your own QR codes for personal and professional use.

QR Code Scanner & Barcode Scanner supports all possible formats of QR Code and Barcodes including Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, Data Matrix, EAN13, EAN8, ITF, UPC A, UPC E, PDF417, AZTEC, and many more. 

Attractive design, robust performance and even caught blurry QR codes. QR & Barcode Scanner is completely free and has no ads.

SIMPLE & CONVENIENT
No internet connection required to access any feature of QR & Barcode Scanner. Easily Scan QR and barcodes from gallery.

ALL COMMON FORMATS SUPPORTED
Scan all QR codes and common barcode formats: QR, Data Matrix, Aztec, UPC, EAN and many more.

QR CODE GENERATOR & BARCODE CREATOR: 
Generate custom QR codes for your business or personal use with our QR code generator and barcode generator. Share your QR codes via social media, email, or print them for your convenience.

RELEVANT ACTIONS
Open URLs connect to WiFi and hotspots; add calendar events, contact, find product price and information, etc.

FLASHLIGHT AND ZOOM FUNCTION
Activate the flashlight for perfect scans in dark areas and use zoom function to read QR code and barcodes from long distances.

BARCODE SCANNER
the barcode scanner is 100% safe and secure! B
